company.name: Coraly
company.shortDescription: Coraly is an AI-powered real estate platform that helps agents and brokerages manage listings, leads, and workflow operations.
company.description: Coraly.ai is a UAE-based proptech company that provides an AI-powered growth platform designed specifically for real estate professionals. The platform aims to help agents save time and grow their business by offering tools for lead enrichment, automated campaigns, 24/7 lead qualification, and performance insights. These solutions help real estate agents acquire and convert more customers, integrating with existing CRM platforms and automating various sales and marketing tasks—such as multi-portal publishing and real-time performance optimization.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered real estate operations platform that combines listing creation, lead qualification, marketing, transaction management, compliance workflows, and reporting for agencies and brokerages.
productsAndServices.name: Growth Platform

productsAndServices.description: A listing management module that uses voice, photos, video, and manual data to create, enrich, organize, and distribute real estate listings.

productsAndServices.description: A lead management and qualification module that automates prospect engagement, scores buying intent, and routes leads to the appropriate real estate agents.
productsAndServices.name: Lead Suite

productsAndServices.description: A real estate marketing production module that creates branded social content, listing copy, flyers, media assets, and other channel-specific materials from listing data.
productsAndServices.name: Marketing Suite

productsAndServices.description: A real estate media-compliance system that detects altered images, generates disclosure text, stores originals, and maintains audit records for brokerages and MLS organizations.
productsAndServices.name: Compliance Suite

productsAndServices.description: A transaction management module that organizes documents, approvals, deadlines, jurisdiction-specific workflows, and audit records for real estate transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Transaction Suite
